projectDescription: A lightweight TypeScript utility library providing async control flow, reactive streams, smart caching, pub/sub messaging, and functional programming helpers for backend and full-stack development.
keyFeatures: Async control flow HOFs: cancelable, queued, execpool, retry, lock, singlerun, afterinit, schedule, timeout
Reactive streams: Observer, Subject, BehaviorSubject, Source factory, and Operator transformers
Smart caching: memoize, cached, ttl (time-to-live), router (per-key), and rate limiting
Pub/Sub messaging with pluggable async queue and map adapters (PubsubArrayAdapter, PubsubMapAdapter)
Async generator-based document iteration: iterateDocuments, iterateUnion, iterateList with offset/cursor pagination
Functional helpers: compose, match, and, or, not, first, last, join, truely, str, has
Specialized data structures: SortedArray, LimitedSet, LimitedMap, ToolRegistry, Lock
Object utilities: deepClone, deepCompare, deepMerge, deepFlat, get, set, create
Type-safe TypeScript API with full generics support
761 tests covering correctness, async exception propagation, and integration chains
publicApiSurface: cancelable(fn) — wrap async function with cancellation support
queued(fn) — serialize async calls into a promise queue
execpool(fn, { maxExec, delay }) — limit concurrent async executions
retry(fn, { retries, delay }) — retry on failure
lock(fn) — mutex for async functions
singlerun(fn) — run only once until cleared
afterinit(fn) — skip calls until first run completes
schedule(fn, params) — defer execution with scheduler callback
timeout(fn, ms) — wrap with timeout, returns TIMEOUT_SYMBOL
memoize(fn, keyFn) — cache by key function
cached(fn) — cache by argument change detection
ttl(fn, { key, timeout }) — time-to-live cache
router(keyFn, invalidateFn, fn) — per-key cached memoization
rate(fn, { key, rate }) — rate limiting by key
debounce(fn, ms) — debounce function calls
throttle(fn, ms) — throttle function calls
singletick(fn) — coalesce calls per event loop tick
singleshot(fn) — run once with memoized result
trycatch(fn, fallback) — try-catch wrapper with fallback
pubsub(config) — pub/sub with PubsubArrayAdapter / PubsubMapAdapter
Observer — full observable implementation with operators
Subject — observable + subscriber
BehaviorSubject — Subject with current value replay
Source — factory: fromArray, fromPromise, fromInterval, fromSubject, merge, join, pipe
Operator — stream transforms: take, skip, distinct, group, pair, strideTricks, liveness, count
waitForNext(subject, predicate) — await subject value matching condition
iterateDocuments(paginator, options) — async generator with offset/cursor pagination
iterateUnion(sources, options) — merge + dedup async generators
iterateList(list, mapFn) — iterate list with async map
paginateDocuments(generator, options) — paginate async document generators
filterDocuments(generator, predicate) — async filter over document generators
mapDocuments(generator, transform) — async map over document generators
pickDocuments(generator, { limit, offset }) — offset-based pick
distinctDocuments(generator, getId) — dedup by id
fetchApi(url, options) — typed fetch wrapper with FetchError
compose(...fns) — right-to-left function composition
match(condition, run) — conditional execution helper
and(...fns) / or(...fns) / not(fn) — boolean combinators (sync + async)
has(collection, value) — membership check for Array/Set/Map
first(arr) / last(arr) — safe first/last element
join(...arrays) — merge arrays with dedup and null removal
str(...parts) — join strings with separators
truely(arr) — filter nulls from array
Lock — class-based mutex: acquireLock / releaseLock
SortedArray — array sorted by numeric score
LimitedSet / LimitedMap — size-capped Set and Map
ToolRegistry — type-safe runtime registry
deepClone / deepCompare / deepMerge / deepFlat — object utilities
get(obj, path) / set(obj, path, value) / create(path, value) — path-based object access
sleep(ms) — promise-based delay
createAwaiter() — promise with external resolve/reject
randomString() — generate UUID-like random string
typo — typography constants (nbsp, emdash, etc.)
